products.name: Advanced 15% Vitamin C Glow Elixir
products.description: A stable, golden ethyl-ascorbic acid serum boosted with Ferulic acid and Alpha-Arbutin. Dramatically fades stubborn dark spots, acne scars, and sun damage while delivering an undeniable glass-skin glow.
products.howToUse: Apply 3-4 drops every morning on clean, slightly damp skin before moisturizer and sunscreen.
products.ingredients: Aqua, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (15%), Niacinamide (3%), Alpha-Arbutin (2%), Ferulic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Phenoxyethanol.

products.name: 10% Niacinamide + 2% Zinc Blemish Stopper
products.description: High-strength vitamin and mineral blemish formula designed to refine enlarged pores, regulate excess oil production, and calm active inflammatory breakouts without drying the face.
products.howToUse: Dispense 2-3 drops day and night onto cleansed face. Follow with your favorite light moisturizer.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Niacinamide (10%), Zinc PCA (2%), Centella Asiatica Extract, Glycerin, Xanthan Gum, Ethylhexylglycerin.

products.name: Invisible Melanin Shield SPF 50+ PA++++
products.description: Finally, a sunblock that leaves ZERO white cast or purple cast on brown and black skin. Water-light, non-greasy, and sweat-resistant formula with hyaluronic acid and green tea antioxidants.
products.howToUse: Apply 2 finger lengths generously as the final step of your morning routine 15 minutes before sun exposure.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, Tocopherol (Vitamin E).

products.name: Purifying Botanical Gel Cleanser
products.description: A gentle, pH-balanced (5.5) cleanser that washes away dirt, oil, and makeup without disrupting your natural moisture barrier. Enriched with chamomile, aloe vera, and tea tree extract.
products.howToUse: Pump twice onto wet hands, massage gently over face in circular motions for 60 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Glycerin, Chamomilla Recutita Extract, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Allantoin.

products.name: Hydra-Plump Rosewater & Hyaluronic Mist
products.description: An instant surge of moisture for thirsty, dull skin. Pure damask rose hydrosol infused with multi-molecular hyaluronic acid and cucumber extract to immediately refresh, plump, and hydrate.
benefits: Sets makeup for a dewy look
products.howToUse: Spritz generously onto clean face morning, night, or throughout the day whenever skin feels tight or dry.
products.ingredients: Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Sodium Hyaluronate, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Glycerin, Panthenol (Vitamin B5), Citric Acid.

products.name: Ceramide Barrier Recovery Cloud Cream
products.description: Intense barrier healing for sensitized, over-exfoliated, or dry skin. Infused with 3 essential skin-identical ceramides, squalane, and soothing centella to seal in moisture and repair damaged texture.
benefits: Heals damaged skin barrier in 5 days
products.howToUse: Smooth a dime-sized amount over face and neck as your morning and bedtime moisturizer.
products.ingredients: Aqua, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Plant Squalane, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Centella Asiatica Extract.

products.name: Whipped Shea & Turmeric Melanin Glow Butter
products.description: Decadently whipped unrefined Nigerian shea butter, sweet almond oil, and golden turmeric extract. Fades body stretch marks, dark knees and elbows, and leaves skin gleaming like pure silk.
products.skinType: All Body Skin, Dry Knuckles & Elbows
benefits: Melts like soft satin on skin
products.howToUse: Massage thoroughly over damp body immediately after bathing for long-lasting glow and silky softness.
products.ingredients: Butyrospermum Parkii (Raw Shea Butter), Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Tocopherol, Natural Citrus Essential Oil.

products.name: The Complete Glass Skin 4-Piece Daily Routine
products.description: Our most celebrated routine bundle! Includes our Purifying Gel Cleanser (150ml), Hydra-Plump Rosewater Mist (120ml), Advanced 15% Vitamin C Glow Elixir (30ml), and Invisible Melanin Shield SPF 50 (50ml). Save ₦11,000!
